occurred_at.description: Timestamp when the audited action happened.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the acting subject when available.

source_service.description: Service name that emitted the audit event.

source_node_id.description: Node or instance identifier of the source service.

action.description: Action that was attempted or completed.

resource_type.description: Type of resource affected by the action.

resource_id.description: Identifier of the affected resource when known.

patient_id.description: Patient identifier related to this event, if applicable.

details.description: Additional structured metadata for this event. For example changed_fields
